key_insight: MobileGym provides a browser-hosted, lightweight mobile environment that captures the full app state as structured JSON, enabling deterministic, verifiable outcome signals and massively parallel low-cost rollouts for RL. This decouples interaction fidelity from proprietary backends while making rewards and evaluation reproducible.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of verifiable outcome signals and scalable, low-cost simulation for everyday mobile GUI agents, where pixel- or backend-dependent setups hinder reproducibility and large-scale RL.
method: Host lightweight mobile app simulations in the browser and capture the entire environment state as structured JSON.
Use deterministic state-based judging over the JSON state to provide verifiable outcome signals and reproducible evaluation.
Support state forking and massively parallel, low-cost rollouts to enable scalable online RL and efficient collection of trajectories.
impact: Enables reproducible benchmarking and reliable reward signals for GUI agents, dramatically lowering the cost and engineering friction for large-scale RL research on mobile apps and accelerating iteration from research to real-world interaction.

paper_title: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
paper_authors: Dingbang Wu, Rui Hao, Haiyang Wang, Shuzhe Wu, Han Xiao
